policy: Use references to extract principles and compare interaction patterns. Do not copy source code, assets, copywriting or complete compositions.

references.name: Impeccable
references.adaptation: Use specialized design intents and deterministic review; keep Integra contracts and evidence explicit.
references.licenseNote: Review upstream license and notices before reusing code. This catalog links and documents concepts only.

references.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
references.adaptation: Apply the method to permitted UI behavior and references; binary analysis is out of scope.
references.licenseNote: Link to upstream documentation; do not copy unrelated implementation.

references.name: WCAG 2.2
references.adaptation: Use normative criteria and exceptions; do not claim full-page conformance from partial checks.

references.name: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
references.adaptation: Prefer native HTML first; use ARIA patterns only when custom widgets are necessary.

references.name: Material Design 3
references.adaptation: Study token and state modeling; do not apply its visual language to every product.

references.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
references.adaptation: Use when the target is an Apple-platform experience.

references.name: Shopify Polaris
references.adaptation: Study task-oriented admin patterns and feedback without replicating branding.

references.name: Microsoft Fluent 2
references.adaptation: Reference for enterprise interaction states and system consistency.

references.name: GOV.UK Design System
references.adaptation: Prioritize clarity and task completion for high-consequence service flows.

references.name: Radix Primitives
references.adaptation: Use primitives where the target stack calls for them; inspect behavior, not just appearance.

references.name: shadcn/ui
references.adaptation: Treat components as source-owned building blocks; customize rather than accepting defaults wholesale.

references.name: Tailwind CSS
references.adaptation: Respect the target project's actual Tailwind version and config.

references.name: MDN Accessibility
references.adaptation: Use primary browser documentation for semantics and APIs.

references.name: Web Vitals
references.adaptation: Use measured metrics from representative sessions.
